title: follower: store own messages on accept, dedup on inner message
description: Implements decision mimid-1wgh.7.30. (1) Regression test first: against a hub that does NOT echo (protocol-06 §5.5), a local user's accepted message and commit must appear in its own provider's follower log; this fails today. (2) Follower relay: on success, store a FanoutMessage (timestamp = accepted_timestamp; frank copied from SubmitMessage; moreProposals/externalProposals copied from Update) in the local log for the room. (3) /notify and LocalDelivery dedup moves from the SHA-256 of the whole FanoutMessage to byte-identity of the inner message, so the mimid hub's echo (H17) and failover duplicates are absorbed whatever their timestamp or frank. Recheck F5's join-point snapshot logic (.7.23) and F6's stream oracle (each provider's stream == A's outbox), which assume echo; changing either is a test change that needs Mark's approval. Check senderMsgId: the draft derives it from the FanoutMessage, so the stored copy and the echo must not produce two Messages.
notes:
Draft update (crate-jmap-50, 2026-10-18): store the accepted FanoutMessage in every bound local Chat, not only the owner's, unless dedup forbids it. mimid's follower log is per room, so one store reaches all local members. Also: hub-stapled externalProposals on the owner's external commit don't reach the owner's other clients through the stored copy; check what mimid's hub staples (H4) and add a test or a documented limitation.
Widened by the approved .12 plan (2026-10-18): (a) also enforce the draft's second dedup rule: no two stored FanoutMessages in a room with the same senderMsgId (unique (room, senderMsgId) column) alongside the inner-message byte-identity rule, in migration 0004 (fixed number); (b) JM-9 (.12.26): refuse a FanoutMessage timestamp >= 2^48 at /notify with 400, extending TimestampOutOfRange; (c) dedup is per room (JM-7, .12.24). .7.31 owns every change to store/follower_log.rs and follower/notify.rs; the JMAP projection only reads.
CHECKPOINT 2026-10-18 (night): implemented in worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-a79433999a9d95e52, uncommitted. Regression tests (tests/follower_own_messages.rs, 11 tests, mock hub that doesn't echo) failed before the fix and pass after it. Five gates green; the test gate fails ONLY on 4 existing tests that assert the superseded echo-only behaviour. NOT landed. FOR MARK, approve these test changes: (1) store/mod.rs:230 migrations [1,2,3] -> [1,2,3,4] (with .11.1's: [1,2,3,4,5]); (2) follower_membership.rs accepted_update_joins_from_the_request_on (L199): the relay now writes its own copy (stored 2, visible [stored[1]]; then 3 / [stored[1],stored[2]]); (3) leave_hides_later_events_until_rejoining (L251): counts shift by the own copies; (4) fanout_overtaking_the_response_is_seen (L345): the racing echo is COMMIT_BOB, so the log has 3 rows (the new test echo_before_the_stored_copy_is_kept covers the matching-echo case). Design: the stored copy goes through store_fanout (same checks and dedup); migration 0004 adds message_hash and sender_msg_id unique per room (pre-0004 rows NULL, not deduplicated: Limitation); JM-9 enforced on /notify and the relay path; moreProposals copied from the request (the draft says the request; the bead said response); FollowerError::Encode added. Limitations: an own copy can land ahead of earlier queued hub events (arrival order, .7.17); stapled externalProposals from a non-mimid hub don't reach the owner's other clients. NEW SPEC QUESTION for Mark: if a committer adds a user on the committer's own provider via a hub that doesn't echo, the Welcome may never reach that provider (the draft stores only proposalOrCommit). Probably a draft or wg item.
2026-10-18 Mark: approved the 4 test changes (applied by orchestrator; membership 6/6, own-messages 11/11, store 17/17 pass); accepted Limitations: own copy may precede earlier queued hub events (.7.17), pre-0004 rows not deduplicated, stapled externalProposals from non-mimid hubs don't reach the owner's other clients (mimid hub never staples, hub/update.rs:76). Welcome question: no code change, filed mimid-1wgh.43.
